technical_map.question: MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？

editorial: FieldToFit分析：这份报告最值得复用的是一条判断链——小实验是否控制了数据曝光，效率比较是否固定质量目标，系统实现是否把FLOPs优势变成实际进展。对训练团队，这是实验设计清单；对模型采用者，则是避免将训练论文直接翻译成产品承诺的方法。
路线连线并列组织需要同时检查的证据，不宣称某一模块独自造成全部增益。原文日期、本站核对及实际发表分开保存，后续若公开检查点或实质修订，再按新证据接续同一入口。
官方网页日期为 2026-10-15，未标编号修订；PDF入口参数v=2 不被解释为已确认的论文v2 或实质修订。本站 2026-10-17 核对，实际上站时间由发布记录维护。完整网页已深读，并交叉核对 13 页PDF中的定义与位置；原图尚未完成逐图视觉复核，本站不复制或数字化原图曲线。原文仅链接，三图为本站原创事实示意。

blocks.text: 把小模型训练得更久，并不一定模拟了大模型的处境。若小实验每次看到新数据，而最终训练要重复同一来源，小实验可能偏爱到了大规模才过拟合的配置。source scaling主动缩小小实验的独特样本池，同时保持各来源重复次数及TPP；它控制的是实验条件，不只是数据总量。

blocks.alt: 两种训练跨度均重复八次的source scaling示例
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 1｜本站示意。5T与 50T、八次重复取自作者示例，不是全部语料的实测配方；未数字化图 2 曲线。

evidence.locator: p4; Figure 2 and source scaling example

blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: 学习率与权重衰减联合搜索，作者改用LR和LR×WD坐标，再拟合训练步数与TPP的关系；这避免把两个耦合量当成彼此独立的旋钮。
这些经验关系先从小规模估计，再在中间规模验证。本站判断是：这种验证链比只公布一条最终训练曲线更能说明配方如何被选中，但不意味着其他数据和优化器可以照抄常数。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 示例中的重复次数与经验超参数关系都有条件，不能当作通用训练默认值。

findings.summary: 预测大训练前，先让小实验的数据曝光与正则化条件可比较。
findings.title: 小模型要重复相似的数据，外推才更可信

blocks.text: 作者没有用最终两台不同大小模型的总训练计算直接宣布节省，而是在代码、问答、STEM和数学四项保留集上分别拟合BPB与训练FLOPs。以DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base的BPB为目标，估计微软阶梯达到相同质量需要多少FLOPs，再与基线训练计算比较。BPB按字节度量，有助于跨tokenizer比较，但仍是指定文本保留集指标。

blocks.alt: 匹配基线BPB后比较所需训练FLOPs的定义示意
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 2｜本站示意，非实验曲线。4.2–12.3 倍为四项独立拟合结果的范围；已知最终终点纳入拟合，不是盲预测。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: 拟合纳入了已经训练完成的MAI-Base-2 终点，因此匹配点位于拟合模型范围内。这个口径比把它叫外推验证更准确，也应与图 2 用于预测终点的阶梯实验分开。
作者明确最终MAI-Base-2 实际使用的训练FLOPs比基线更多，并把配方效率投入更大的模型。效率提升和总支出下降是不同问题，报告未给出可推导API价格或完整训练账单的依据。

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 这里的可审结论是“同一保留集质量目标下的估计训练计算更少”，不是最终模型总成本更低。

evidence.locator: pp4–5; Isolating modeling efficiency from compute

findings.summary: 先固定质量目标，再问训练配方需要多少计算。
findings.title: 4.2–12.3 倍是在等BPB处比较，不是实际账单

blocks.text: 微软称全层MoE此前在FLOPs上占优，却因实现开销在实际时间上不如隔层布局。新版把专家分组，为每个专家设固定token容量，用额外轮次处理溢出，并允许同组使用空闲容量；少分配内存可能意味着更多轮次，不是消除代价。通信与计算重叠、设备端元数据和批量归约减少了每专家开销。

blocks.alt: 固定内存多轮MoE，以及分母不同的 21% MFU与 89% goodput
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 3｜本站定性示意，不表示真实耗时比例。整次训练MFU 21%与goodput 89%分母不同，不能相减或当作同一利用率。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: MoE层MFU由 24%到 35%是局部实现结果；整次训练MFU为 21%，按每卡 2.5 PFLOPS归一，排除重计算和优化器FLOPs。goodput 89%则表示有训练进展的时间占比。
Muon需要完整矩阵做正交化，和分片优化器有张力；实现通过重分片及通信重叠处理。作者报告每步 165 ms、占 2.1%，理论 55 ms仍有差距，保留尾部等待、调度、负载不均和复制分配等解释。
激活梯度裁剪针对局部异常，避免一小部分样本牵连整批权重梯度；还帮助追到预处理截断许可头的错误。报告把方法收益与数据诊断连起来，但没有逐项隔离最终模型全部增益。

findings.summary: 计算上更稀疏的选择，也可能输给通信、碎片和尾部等待。
findings.title: 全层MoE能否划算，要同时看内存和真实训练时间

blocks.text: MAI-Base-2 以无编码器VLM方式原生预训练视觉。作者称独特训练token比上代约增 36%，视觉语料含 4.5T独特token，重复后视觉数据占 50T混合的 18%。独特样本量、重复曝光量和混合占比分母不同，本文保留各自单位，不反推未公布的数据明细。

items: 代码保留集是微软内部代码库；STEM、数学和问答集由供应商提供并进行去污染。它们能支持报告内BPB比较，不能替代开放任务集复现或你的业务质量评测。
Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 和MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL的可用对照已后训练，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base则是底座。作者已注明后训练可能影响结果，不将这张表写成统一纯预训练竞赛。
官方仍说模型在后训练，未来通过Foundry向可信合作伙伴许可权重是计划，不写成已公开下载或普遍可调用。训练数据知识截止为 2026-03，也不是报告发布日期。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: FieldToFit判断：这是一份有方法和工程细节的训练报告；可帮助判断实验设计，尚不能替代独立复现、应用评测或取得模型的实际条件。

evidence.locator: pp1–3 and pp11–13; Scaling Data and What’s next

findings.summary: 语料规模、基准结论和未来产品入口不能互相替代。
findings.title: 原生视觉训练已纳入，公开可用性仍需另看

title: MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？

fields.16k GB200，38 天；MFU按每卡 2.5 PFLOPS归一。: 16k GB200 over 38 days; MFU normalized to 2.5 PFLOPS per GPU.
fields.2.8T总参数、80B激活、50T训练token；16k GB200、38 天。: 2.8T total and 80B active parameters; 50T training tokens; 16k GB200 GPUs over 38 days.
fields.4.2–12.3 倍是在等BPB处比较，不是实际账单: 4.2–12.3 times compares matched BPB, not actual bills
fields.4.5T与 18%分母不同，不能直接相除为独特语料占比。: 4.5T and 18% use different denominators; do not divide them into a unique-corpus share.
fields.FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术: Original factual diagram by FieldToFit, based on the official Microsoft AI technical article.
fields.FieldToFit分析：这份报告最值得复用的是一条判断链——小实验是否控制了数: FieldToFit analysis: the reusable decision chain asks whether small experiments control data exposure, efficiency comparisons fix a quality target, and systems turn FLOPs advantages into real progress. For training teams it guides experiments; for adopters it prevents turning a training paper into unsupported product promises.
fields.FieldToFit判断：这是一份有方法和工程细节的训练报告；可帮助判断实验设计: FieldToFit assessment: this report offers useful experimental and engineering detail, but cannot replace independent reproduction, application evaluation or actual access conditions.
fields.Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 和MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL的可用对照已后: Available Kimi K3, Qwen3.8 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL comparators are post-trained, while DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base is a base checkpoint. Post-training may affect results, so the table is not a uniform base-pretraining contest.
fields.MAI-Base-2 以无编码器VLM方式原生预训练视觉。作者称独特训练toke: MAI-Base-2 uses native encoder-free VLM pre-training. Unique training tokens grow about 36% over the predecessor; the vision corpus has 4.5T unique tokens and, after repetition, contributes 18% of the 50T mixture. Unique volume, repeated exposure and mixture shares use different denominators; we do not infer undisclosed data details.
fields.MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？: MAI-Base-2: turning pre-training efficiency into a reliable large-scale run
fields.MFU排除重计算和优化器FLOPs，goodput为有训练进展的时间比例。: MFU excludes recomputation and optimizer FLOPs; goodput is the fraction of time with training progress.
fields.MoE层MFU由 24%到 35%是局部实现结果；整次训练MFU为 21%，按每: MoE-layer MFU from 24% to 35% is a local implementation result. Whole-run MFU is 21%, normalized to 2.5 PFLOPS per GPU and excluding recomputation and optimizer FLOPs. Goodput 89% is the fraction of time with training progress.
fields.Muon分片重组与通信重叠；激活梯度裁剪抑制局部异常。: Muon resharding and communication overlap; activation-gradient clipping targets local outliers.
fields.Muon需要完整矩阵做正交化，和分片优化器有张力；实现通过重分片及通信重叠处理。: Muon needs full matrices for orthogonalization, creating tension with optimizer sharding. Resharding and communication overlap address this. The authors report 165 ms per step, or 2.1%, with a remaining gap to theoretical 55 ms due to stragglers, scheduling, imbalance and copies/allocations.
fields.source scaling缩小独特样本池，保持重复次数和TPP。: Source scaling restricts unique samples while preserving repetitions and TPP.
fields.不是实际总费用或API价格倍数。: Not a multiplier for actual total cost or API pricing.
fields.不是已核实的公开权重或通用API交付。: Not a verified public-weight or general API release.
fields.两种训练跨度均重复八次的source scaling示例: Source-scaling illustration with eight repetitions at two training horizons
fields.仍在后训练，未来可信合作伙伴权重许可不是当前开放下载。: Ongoing post-training and future partner weight licensing are not current public downloads.
fields.代码保留集是微软内部代码库；STEM、数学和问答集由供应商提供并进行去污染。它们: Held-out code uses Microsoft’s internal codebase; STEM, math and QA sets are vendor-commissioned and decontaminated. They support within-report BPB comparisons, not open-task reproduction or business-quality evaluation.
fields.作者MoE层MFU由 24%升至 35%，使全层MoE成为可用选择。: Authors raise MoE-layer MFU from 24% to 35%, enabling MoE in every layer.
fields.作者报告 4.2–12.3 倍FLOPs效率；最终大模型实际训练计算更多。: Authors report 4.2–12.3 times FLOPs efficiency; the final large model actually used more training compute.
fields.作者明确最终MAI-Base-2 实际使用的训练FLOPs比基线更多，并把配方效: The final MAI-Base-2 run explicitly uses more training FLOPs than the baseline, investing recipe efficiency in a larger model. Efficiency and lower total spending are different questions; the report does not establish API prices or a complete training bill.
fields.作者没有用最终两台不同大小模型的总训练计算直接宣布节省，而是在代码、问答、STE: Rather than declaring savings from total compute of two differently sized final models, the authors fit BPB against training FLOPs independently for held-out code, QA, STEM and math. They estimate the ladder compute needed to match DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base BPB, then compare it with baseline training compute. BPB measures by byte and helps compare tokenizers, while remaining a metric for specified held-out text.
fields.作者结果未复现；部分基准私有、部分对照已后训练；模型仍在后训练。原文图表仅链接，: Author results are not reproduced; some benchmarks are private and some comparators post-trained. The model is still in post-training. Original charts are linked only; our diagrams illustrate facts rather than experimental curves.
fields.先固定质量目标，再问训练配方需要多少计算。: Fix the quality target before asking how much compute a recipe needs.
fields.全层MoE能否划算，要同时看内存和真实训练时间: Whether all-layer MoE pays off depends on memory and elapsed training time
fields.公开报告与可取得模型分开: Separate public reporting from model access
fields.分组固定专家容量，多轮dispatch／compute／collect，不丢弃溢: Group experts with fixed capacities and repeated dispatch / compute / collect, retaining overflow tokens.

fields.微软把数据重复规律、超参数外推和万卡系统放在同一条训练路线中。本文以四条结论、对: Microsoft connects repeated-data behavior, hyperparameter scaling and a large GPU system in one training recipe. Four findings, matching arguments and three original diagrams explain matched-quality compute, fixed-memory MoE and training utilization. FieldToFit has not reproduced the experiments.
fields.微软称全层MoE此前在FLOPs上占优，却因实现开销在实际时间上不如隔层布局。新: Microsoft says MoE in every layer previously won on FLOPs but lost on elapsed time to alternating layers. The new design groups experts with fixed token capacities, handles overflow in extra rounds and borrows spare capacity within a group. Less memory can mean more rounds; the tradeoff remains. Communication overlap, device metadata and batched reductions reduce per-expert overhead.
fields.把小模型训练得更久，并不一定模拟了大模型的处境。若小实验每次看到新数据，而最终训: Training a small model longer does not necessarily reproduce the large model’s conditions. If small runs keep seeing fresh examples while the final run repeats sources, the experiment can favor settings that overfit only at scale. Source scaling restricts unique samples in smaller runs while preserving source repetitions and TPP: it controls experimental conditions, not just volume.
fields.把训练方法、计算口径和工程条件一起读: Read the recipe, compute definition and engineering conditions together

Our assessment: this validation chain explains recipe selection better than a final training curve alone, while not making the constants transferable to other data and optimizers.
fields.这里的可审结论是“同一保留集质量目标下的估计训练计算更少”，不是最终模型总成本更: The reviewable claim is less estimated compute at a matched held-out quality target, not lower total cost for the final model.
fields.配方效率要连同可比较的实验条件和真实系统代价判断；少用FLOPs的能力，不自动等: Judge recipe efficiency with comparable experimental conditions and real system costs; needing fewer FLOPs does not automatically lower the final training bill.
